item.title: Matrix Multiplication Optimization
item.description:
Optimizing Matrix Multiplication

Outline:

  • Intro: optimize matrix multiplication
    • Learn benchmarking (JMH, flame graphs)
    • Using scala, but not functional
    • Code on GitHub
  • Naive
  • Flat
  • Transpose
  • Accumulator
  • Blocks
    • slow
    • flame graph
    • nested forEach
    • fast
  • Parallel
    • block size
    • thread count
  • final table

Matrix multiplication is a great test case to understand performance optimization. The underlying algorithm is fairly simple, and it benefits measurably from some classic optimizations like:

  • reducing array accesses
  • sequential memory access
  • cache locality
  • parallelization
